prBodyNotes: Pin policy (GH #103): any change to the workspace Cargo.lock must sync benchmarks/tablo/Cargo.lock in the same commit, keeping topcoat/toasty revs identical.

Topcoat and Toasty are git dependencies Renovate never updates: they are pinned to exact revs and bumped deliberately with cargo xtask bump-upstream, never by a blanket cargo update (AGENTS.md "Renovate PRs", CONTRIBUTING.md "Dependency pins"). The workspace lock stays in lockstep with benchmarks/tablo/Cargo.lock.
